entities.name: Q9M7Z1 BCKDH E2
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Arabidopsis thaliana mitochondrial lipoamide acyltransferase component of the branched-chain alpha-ketoacid dehydrogenase complex; EC 2.3.1.168.
Transfers branched-chain acyl groups from acyl-CoA to the covalently lipoylated E2 lysine arm; annotation lists isobutyryl-, isovaleryl-, and 2-methylbutanoyl-CoA examples.

entities.name: BCKDH E2 acyl transfer
observations: General reaction: lipoyl-E2 + branched-chain acyl-CoA → S-acyl-dihydrolipoyl-E2 + CoA; the acyl group is transferred onto the lipoyl arm for subsequent processing by the multienzyme complex.
